inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A battle stage in the land of the Bloodridge, a sun cult of faceless hooded guardians, the same people as their settlement in the camp: low tents of rotted sepia and ash brown rags, tall black stone obelisks with thin glowing ember cracks, ragged banners with a dark red sun disc on poles, bronze braziers, ram skulls and burial bandages hung on poles, temples in the manner of ancient Egypt. Ash brown, sepia and corroded bronze with ember light, in bright clear full colour. Ember light glows only in the cracks of the obelisks and in braziers, never on the ground. Only the few things named for this place stand here, along the far edge; nothing else is built anywhere in the picture. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. No people anywhere, the fighters are added later. This place: the night market, their city of the dead by moonlight.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "a bright readable battle stage in a real lived in place of a sun cult, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth and scale, readable silhouettes, the open ground calm and even so fighters read on it", "lighting": "Cool bright moonlight from the upper left and warm lantern light, deep blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground pale and lit so it reads clearly.", "color_palette": ["#0e1430", "#1e2a5a", "#3a4a8a", "#dfe6f2", "#8a2a28", "#f0b050", "#c8c8d4", "#9aa0b4", "#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade fighting game stage, no people, with real depth in clear planes like a stage in a modern pixel art game: the sky and the far land at the top, a middle terrace with smaller things further away, then the landmarks of this place standing along the far edge of the open ground with their feet on one line a third of the way down, and at the far left and far right a few nearer pieces standing at the edge of the ground. Everything in the middle below that line is one wide open flat ground where two armies will fight, calm and empty, with nothing standing on it.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 221,
